  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained on longer journeys, and the integrated 911 Assist feature adds an extra layer of safety and peace of mind. FordPass Connect enables remote vehicle access and management through your smartphone.

Safety systems work continuously to protect your family. Dual front and side impact airbags, along with overhead airbags, provide comprehensive protection. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to confident handling, while the rear parking camera assists with visibility when reversing.

The silver exterior pairs with practical details designed for durability and convenience. Heated door mirrors defrost quickly in cold weather, the rear window wiper keeps visibility clear, and body-color bumpers maintain a cohesive appearance. Front and second row floor liners protect your investment from daily wear and weather.

At 53,485 miles, this Explorer XLT represents a well-maintained option ready for the next chapter of your ownership. We invite you to schedule a time to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover why the Explorer remains a trusted choice for families and individuals alike.

This 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport offers genuine capability wrapped in a Red exterior that commands attention on any road.

- Trailer Tow & HD Electrical Group with Class II Receiver Hitch
- Black 3-Piece Hard Top with Freedom Panel Storage Bag
- 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Uconnect 4 with 7" Display and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with Emergency Communication System
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Jeep Trail Rated Kit
- 700 Amp Maintenance Free Battery with 240 Amp Alternator
- Rear Window Defroster and Rear Window Wiper/Washer
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Front Fog Lights with Delay-Off Headlights
- Dual Front Impact and Side Impact Airbags
- Split Folding Rear Seat with Front Bucket Seats
- 17" Black Steel Styled Wheels

With 60,608 miles on the odometer, this Wrangler Unlimited has been maintained and is ready for the next chapter of adventure. The 3.6L V6 engine delivers the power you expect from a Jeep, while the 8-speed automatic transmission provides smooth performance whether you're navigating city streets at 19 MPG city or cruising highways at 24 MPG. The combination of 4-wheel drive capability and the Jeep Trail Rated Kit means you're equipped to handle diverse terrain with confidence.

The hard top configuration offers weather protection and security, while the removable Freedom Panels provide flexibility when you want to enjoy open-air driving. The rear window defroster and wiper ensure clear visibility in all conditions. Inside, the Uconnect 4 system with a 7-inch display keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, while SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options.

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and traction control working in concert to help protect you and your passengers. The ParkView rear back-up camera assists with parking and reversing, while the four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. The dual battery system and robust 240-amp alternator ensure reliable electrical performance even when powering accessories.

Practical features include cloth low-back bucket seats in front with a split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space. Climate control and power steering make daily driving comfortable, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel accommodates drivers of various preferences. The front center armrest with storage adds convenience for everyday items.

The Trailer Tow & HD Electrical Group makes this Wrangler Unlimited ready for towing applications, complete with a Class II receiver hitch and 7 & 4 pin wiring harness.
